nom: The Ordinary Saccharomyces Ferment 30% Milky Toner for Gentle Exfoliation and Hydration

avis.titre: Works well but has a bad smell
avis.texte: I really love how this makes my skin look and feel but it smells like my sourdough starter or stale beer. Sometimes it's fine but other times it makes me gag from the smell

avis.titre: Great for skin but bad smell
avis.texte: I've been using this toner for three weeks now and it has cleared my skin up a lot. The only problem with it though is that it smells like I'm putting straight vinegar on my face.

I love this toner! As I've gotten older, I've noticed that my skin gets more irritated by the strong toners I used to use on my oily skin. This toner is the perfect balance between nourishing and cleansing, and it doesn't cause any redness or irritation.

avis.titre: So pretty but made me breakout
avis.texte: I love the way this looks and feels, its glowy and hydrating, but unfortunately it causes breakouts. I have moderately dry, mildly sensitive skin, and I dont typically have breakouts. Will have to trash this one 😔

Currently on my second bottle of this milky toner and I love it. Its absorbs nicely into my dry skin and works as a great base for all my other skincare products. Leaves my skin nice and glowing even if worn alone under moisturizer. Will be repurchase again!
I love how gentle this product is! Its gentle enough to use in the same routine as retinol. My skin drinks this stuff right up! Smells like bread.
Feels nice and hydrating. Hasn't broke me out. I would recommend it, but I also want to try out the Thayer's milky toner as well. Nothing to crazy.

I go to the dermatologist on top of using the ordinary products. Sometimes its not the product thats breaking you out, its what your consuming. When i saw this toner i was super excited. I bought it yesterday, used it this morning. Along with the beta moisturizer. My skin feels smooth and soft.

avis.titre: I love the toning step in a skincare routine
avis.texte: I have been enjoying this toner. I can't say its life changing but it I do feel clean and hydrated after using it. If you don't know what ferment means, then know it means "comes with funky smell". It's not overbearing but it is there.

DO NOT get this product if you're acne prone. it is literally made of YEAST and will cause fungal acne. i was just looking for a milky toner and didn't realize this and was so confused why i was breaking out so bad. breakout prone babes, save your skin and your money. don't get this 🙅🏻‍♀️

Was 90% sure this was going to break me out considering it was a hydration toner, but it didn't. Does the absolute best at keeping your skin hydrated all day, especially if paired with Hyaluronic Acid. Exfoliates dare I say better than the Glycolic Acid Toner, I never seen so much dead skin just slide off with no irritation. Great product!

This toner gave me the worst break out I've had in years within two days of using it (without any other changes to my skincare routine). Maybe i just have sensitive skin but id be cautious about this product if you have acne prone or sensitive skin.

This toner is so gentle on skin making it perfect for sensitive skin. It smooths any bumps within about two weeks of use. Applies smoothly under makeup and feels so moisturizing. I used twice a day and noticed significant improvement in two weeks.

This is the first milky toner I've ever used and, while I don't have others to compare it to - I love how this toner has made my skin look and feel. Especially how it absorbs and absolutely leaves my face feeling quenched but not yucky. It just sinks into my skin and I love how soft it feels.

I have chronicallg dry skin in the winter with major flaking (almost in plaques) and redness. I haven't had any AT. ALL. so far this winter!!! I'm out in the cold a lot too which doesn't help and this has been such a game changer!
All the ingredients were sooo harsh for my skin, which is usually not sensitive at all. I broke out with a rash immediately and it dried my skin out so bad.

avis.titre: My holy grail for winter time dehydration
avis.texte: The Ulta rep recommended this product for my dry skin in the winter due to its softening and exfoliating properties. This has become my holy grail! Before finding this product I would pile on moisturizers and humectants but still have to deal with flaking skin, but no more since using this product! 10/10

I bought this on a whim as a budget toner - omg I'm so glad I did. I use this most mornings and nights after washing my face, and I have noticed a huge difference after a few weeks. My skin looks much brighter and feels so smooth. I now wear less foundation and my makeup also just sits better on top of my skin since I started using this. It also helped to clear up some stubborn acne I had on my neck/jawline. Will be repurchasing again and again!

I decided to try this milky toner on a whim after reading a bunch of articles about how beneficial milky toners are for hydration. I can't recommend this product enough… In the summer it's very humid where i live and when I went to bed at night all I would need is this milky toner and I was good to go. You really can't beat the price point for such a high-quality product either. Go get you one!!!

I'm 35, and I've had deep acne scars for my entire adult life. I've spent that whole time trying to find something to help my skin, and this product is a godsend. I've only been using it for two weeks, and my skin has never looked better!

I never take the time to leave reviews, but this had a hand in changing my skin. This significantly helled my redness almost instantly. It calmed my skin, helped repair my skin barrier and all over moisturized really well. I use this with my Avene Tolerance cream, and I swear I'll never have to buy another duo again.

I have never tried a milky toner before but i seen this at Ulta and thought why not! At first i wasn't crazy about it, my skin felt a little oily after applying but after 20 minutes in sunk into my skin and felt soft and not oily anymore. I have been using this for 2 weeks now and i am shocked at how this stuff has diminished the redness in my skin. If you have any redness from rosacea, razor/wax burn or tweezer scars you need to give this a try! I would say my redness is 75% improved so far.

This milky toner is gentle and soothing on the skin. My bottle lasted about 2 months using most mornings. The bottle has a reducer which I prefer to a bottle that just pours out but you have to shake quite hard to get product out. I would shake a nickle size amount into my palm and pat over my face and neck. The toner has a mild slightly sour milk scent to it but it is not offensive and disappears quickly. This is a good choice if you are looking for a light toner to brighten your complexion.
I didn't know what to expect, but it makes my skin so supple and moisturized. Definitely not a need, but I like having it.

avis.titre: My skin hasn't felt normal for years
avis.texte: I have crazy sensitive skin. Almost everything I touch burns my skin, but this is gold. I think this is just what I needed to help. Fix a problem that I've had for about 10 years. My skin actually feels like skin for once.

I've always struggled with kp and always had a good amount of texture on my skin. This has drastically reduced all the little bumps on my cheeks. I still have some because skin will always have texture and I don't use it twice a day so I'm sure I'd get even better results if i did it 2x a day. It's very gentle and hydrating, and I dont smell anything and I am normally sensitive to smells. Its crazy how quick and effectively it has worked. I see a big difference. I'm so happy. I will definitely keep using this!
I love this toner! It genuinely helps my skin especially cause my skin is pretty dry too I think it evens out my skin texture too!

I love this profuct I swear by it! Im on my third bottle. I have never gotten so many compliments on my skin the only thing I have changed in my routine is adding this toner. Ive noticed my skin alof more smooth it gets rid of texture as well as helps even out the skin especially with hyperpigmentation I get due to pimples. I have also noticed my pores have gotten significantly smaller after using this toner.

Listen, i loved this toner. I loved hudrsting it was and how light weight it was. I wasnt the biggest fan of the smell but i could get over it. Then i started breaking out in these itty bitty pimples, jo big deal i get acne normally. Then they started getting itchy and super red. Dry. Come across a photo of fungal acne and thats EXACTLY what my skin looked like. Fungal acne comes from too much yeast on your skin, and considering this is pretty much yeast, i knee it was this product. I wish it worked for me.

I really wanted to love this product since The Ordinary has such great products. However, I did not like this at all. The smell was terrible and felt sticky on my face. It also created some break outs on my face unfortunately. I have combination oily skin that can be acne prone, and it was not good for it.
Unfortunately this did not work for me. I was looking for a good exfoliator that was lighter than the glycolic acid, but all it did was make me break out.

Let me start off by saying, THIS MILKY TONER IS AMAZING!! I have sensitive skin& I have tried MANY toners& this by far is THE BEST! It has cleared up my dark spots& I got 2 pimples 4 days ago. Twice a day, they are barely there! GET THIS TONER!!

I really love this toner, im a big fan of thayers witch hazel toners, but decided to try this one because I love The Ordinary line products. In two weeks my face has gotten way clearer and has gotten rid of my uneven skin tones!

avis.titre: Was good until it broke me out
avis.texte: I used this for about three months when it first came out, and I especially loved it as it got rid of the dryness around the corners of my mouth. I started having an intense acne breakout around the same time and figured out it was this product causing it! I'm not typically acne-prone, but this toner gave me some of the worst cystic acne of my life that took months to clear after discontinuing use. It's a shame that it worked for everything else on my skin, but I was ashamed to take photos of myself during this time.

I am a natural redhead with sensitive skin. I get welts on my skin when I shower without a filter on the shower or if I use soap that isn't natural.. So i enjoy when i find products my skin likes. My skin loves this. I always wake up glowing with no irritation when I use it before bed. Some ppl claim it evens skin tone I haven't seen that so far but I have seen more moisture and I will continue to use and come back after the use of my second or third bottle for a update.
My fault for not seeing the ounces when ordering online. Tiny!

On here buying my 3rd bottle. Ove found that it is incredibly normalizing. I put it on at night after washing, with only eye cream - then mornings depending on what other toner i want, I usually will just add a shake to my palm with my moisturizer. It has shrink my pores and I love that it gives it an even glow. Theres a woman talking about the ingredients and how it was an old Russian secret below. That's awesome and what sold me on this lol. Seriously, give it a try. I'm 42, occasional acne, combo skin

I went on the Ordinary's website to see what to not combine this product with and do not consider myself someone with sensitive skin and have no known allergies and this still gave me the same complaint others are stating about res, flaky, burning skin. Wouldnt risk using this.

This for sure works to hydrate and really get the bouncy-milky look that you would want for a toner, and for the price compared to other brands how can one say no? But for people with sebaceous dermatitis like me, this has fermented yeast that will activate a flare, just use with caution.

Not gonna lie, it did exactly what it claimed the benefits were. The change wasn't dramatic overnight, but with consistent use over two weeks, I started noticing my blemishes getting lighter and my sebaceous filaments shrinking a lot. It smells like fermented rice, but the scent doesn't linger. I'd recommend pairing it with a vitamin C or Konjac serum for even more brightening effects, or a hydrating toner/serum for more hydration.

I've been dealing with stubborn breakouts for a while, and this toner has honestly been a game-changer. Within just a couple of weeks, I noticed a major difference in the clarity and texture of my skin. It feels refreshing when applied, doesn't sting or dry me out, and best of all—it actually works. My breakouts have significantly reduced, and any flare-ups that do happen heal much faster. I also love that it leaves my skin feeling clean and balanced without being harsh. Definitely a staple in my skincare routine now!
Immediately saw a difference! I put this on in the morning and my makeup looks dewy throughout the day. I have also seen a change in my breakouts for the better! Recommend this for sure!

For reference, I have extremely sensitive skin that is on the drier side. This is my favorite toner to use in the morning. I use it after I wash my face and have never experienced any irritation. It has only left me with a perfectly smooth base for the rest of my skincare and makeup. I find the exfoliation to be gentle and the results to be glowy, hydrated looking skin.

avis.titre: Gave me a rash and lots bumps on my face
avis.texte: Do not use this if you have an allergy to fermented ingredients in skincare, and if you have fungal acne because this would make it flare up really bad. I shouldn't known better smh
I have dry, sensitive skin and will always repurchase this! It's great for skin prep before makeup.

avis.titre: I didn't think this product would actually help
avis.texte: For the past year or so I've struggled with random whitehead breakouts (bacterial perhaps?) that happen overnight even when I used actives like retinol or BHA, etc. I bought this product just to try something new and the first time I used it I didn't notice any changes, but after 3-4 days of consistency I noticed my breakouts subsided DRASTICALLY and the overall texture of my skin has improved. This makes me happy because nothing seemed to help my breakouts! The fact that this product costs so much less than everything else I've tried and actually WORKS - I will happily repurchase and recommend to everyone.
This toner is everything. My skin tone is so smooth and my pores are tighter. Almost done the whole first bottle and I will be ordering again.

I have been using this toner for 2 weeks now, at least once daily and sometimes twice. I noticed improved hydration upon first use, and am now beginning to see improved texture and appearance from the gentle exfoliation. I like that the ferment basically nips the dead skin in the bud to prevent it from building up on my face, especially in my t-zone area where I typically got the most dead skin buildup. Definitely do a patch test before applying to your whole face.
helps keep my skin clear and moisturized right after cleansing. Far more budget friendly and works just as or almost as well in my opinion

im really bummed this didnt work for me. i wouldnt normally say i have super sensitive skin, but this gave me whats essentially a mild rash all over my face and neck. i wish i knew which ingredient in this toner caused it. i only used it for 3 or 4 days and now a week later the reaction is barely cleared up :(

The Ordinary is my favorite go to for any skin care, they have the best line of products that actually work. This Milky toner is so smooth I use it in the mornings after cleansing my face. You can tell there is yeast in it by the smell but I rather smell the active ingredient then chemicals.
This is a great toner. The first milky variety I have ever tried. Will repurchase!
I like how this makes my skin feel compared to ant other toner I've used.

This milk toner has made my skin improve a lot and the results speak for themselves. My skin feels rested and I've been hydrated most of the day. And I love that it has diminished the appearance of a blemish on my face. complimentary from theordinary

Complimentary from the Ordinary. This essence is lightweight and it makes my skincare feel very hydrated! It layers really nicely. The essence does not irritate my acne. Thjs product soothes my acne. My skin feels hydrated and prepped for skincare and for my makeup.

This new release from The Ordinary promises hydration and skin protection in one simple step. The formula feels lightweight and refreshing, making it great for everyday use. It absorbs well without leaving residue, but those with very dry skin may need additional moisture. A solid choice for a minimal routine. Complimentary from the ordinary

The ordinary multi-active delivery essence , is a hydrating, perfect for you daily routine I have been using in the morning and at night after cleansing my face. . I have not experienced any irritation, it is unscented, it is a essence but to me it reminds me of a toner I received this product complimentary from the Ordinary in exchange for my honest opinion.

I enjoyed using this product. It provided skin texture and hydration levels. I loved this essence and the way it felt on my skin. I enjoyed using this product. I would highly recommend this product in family and friends. Gifted by the ordinary.

This toner is so good very nice. The right consistency very light hydrating moisturizer. I have really enjoyed using this and incorporating it in my routine. It helps other make up and my other skin care. Gifted by theordinary
I live the smell and feel. It makes my skin texture smoother & brighter and makes it feel so soft right after application!
I love this stuff my skin has never felt so moisturized and soft.

I bought this toner several months ago, I'm on my third bottle now so I obviously like the results. I have mature skin that has some redness and texture. Gycolic toners are now too harsh but this one is very soothing and leaves my skin soft and smooth. There has been improvement in the redness, too. The smell is of yeast so no flowery smell but that doesn't bother me.
Ordering another bottle so I don't run out. I use it 2 times a day and my skin is GLOWING

I really wanted to love it, especially since I've been looking for a good milky toner. Unfortunately, it broke me out after about 2 weeks of using— after stopping using it, my skin has started to clear again. The smell is kind of weird too… definitely not for acne-prone girlies or people fighting fungal acne.
Burns and made my skin peel. I threw it out. I love ordinary products but this one is a no for me.

For a point of reference i have been using the Glycolic toner from the Ordinary prior and i wasn't impressed with this product as much as the other. It is definitely gentle. I didnt care for the yeast smell. If you super sentiive skin, this would be great for you. It isn't harsh, doesn't burn, and leaves your skin soft.
I'm really upset because I really liked this at first. It made my skin so soft and bright. Then after a few days I noticed it broke me out. I had to return it but I wish it wouldve worked.
I'm really upset because I really liked this at first. It made my skin so soft and bright. Then after a few days I noticed it broke me out. I had to return it but I wish it wouldve worked.

I am in my 40's and have slightly sensitive skin. I purchased this to clear up some very minor dullness/uneven skin tone. I am not prone to breakouts, never have been, but from the moment I started using this I developed TERRIBLE, painful breakouts, EVERYWHERE. These subsequently cleared up the moment I stopped using this product. May work for some people but was disastrous for my skin.
I love using this as my first step after washing. It makes my skin feel so soft already.
I have rosacea & acne, so my face is dry and red. I added this to my skincare regimen and it seems to be giving me a nice glow! It's lightweight and feels nice on my skin.

I added this milky toner to my skin care regimen to hopefully help with some minor texture issues and hoooooo boy that was a mistake. Not only did it cause breakouts, it also created dry patches like I've never had (I'm pretty oily). It's taken me more than a month to heal my skin after using it for just a few weeks and I'm still trying to clear up the fallout. Woof.

this product is so good, makes my skin so soft and it doesnt peel after i put moisturizer on and make up, however, i am not acne prone, i just have dry skin skin so be aware of breakouts for those who are acne prone because i have seen reviews that say it broke them out. but as for me i would recommend this product to everyone with slightly dry skin around your nose area.

Do not use if you're prone to fungal acne, the fermented ingredients here will feed that acne causing you to have a bad reaction on your skin aka small bumps and redness and itchiness. Wish I got my money back :')

avis.titre: A great toner for sensitive skin
avis.texte: My skin is on the sensitive side and I love this product. I was using the glycolic acid toner and while it was good, it did seem to bring out the redness in my skin more than I would like. When I changed to this toner I no longer had that problem. It does its job as a lightly exfoliating toner but still feels soothing. It definitely doesn't have the sting of the old toners (Seabreeze anyone? My fellow GenXers know). I use this after I cleanse with the Squalane cleanser and before the serums that I love . I highly recommend this toner.

This broke me out. Every time I used it, within 24 hours I'd have 1 or 2 small pimples. I stopped using it for a few days and it stopped happening; I started it back up and the pimples came back, so this is the culprit. Obviously this is uncommon since it has so many good reviews, but this is my 3rd Ordinary product that's been a flop for me so I think they're just not for me.

avis.titre: If it makes your lips feel fuzzy stop using it
avis.texte: From the first time I used this it made my lips feel weirdly fuzzy even though I didn't use it near my lips. I still continued to use it for about a month and I felt like it was an alright toner for my skin aside from the weird feeling on my lips. Eventually my lips started to shred. Like, not just peel from being dry, but shred like I've never experienced. After about a week of that I stopped using the toner altogether. Within a few days the corners of my mouth became open sores that would crack and bleed then scab over. I'm now using an anti fungal ointment that is helping to heal the corners of my mouth. I guess this toner made my lips peel to the point it made me susceptible to an infection? So long story short: if this makes your lips feel funny just return it, don't keep using it.
I really wanted to like this but unfortunately it made my skin breakout. Pretty bad on my nose and chin.
My face is very acne prone and any makeup looks cracky and dry and mousturizers do not help. This ordinary milky toner softened my skin and made it sp glowy. I will always buy it now.

Lets face it skin care products are expensive. However, this toner works with an amazing price. I have oily skin so sebaceous filaments are often on my chin and Tzone. This toner gently hydrates and exfoliates keeping them at a minimum. I'd definitely repurchase.

For trying something new and having dry skin. I thought this was peferct to use. NOT! It really cause my face to have a TERRIBLE reaction. It gave me redness, itchiness, dry, "white head" pinples all over my chin upper lip and around the nose. Also, peeling skin. Thank goodness im healing but never again!

I have dry mature skin with some texture. This is a nice gentle exfoliator, but it just wasn't enough for my skin. I'm giving 3 stars because of the packaging. Product tends to builds up around the opening of the bottle.

My skin has transformed over the last couple months since introducing this product into my regimen. I noticed the best results when I started applying it as soon as I finish showering, patting my face dry and putting a couple drops directly on the skin vs using it the traditional toner way (cotton pad). Make sure you give it a good shake too.

I have tried SO many skincare products, most of which either seem to make my skin break out or don't make any real noticeable difference (many other Ordinary products included). This toner, however… GAME CHANGER. My skin has never looked more glowy and smooth. Breakouts are pretty much non-existent when I use this, and if I have to go a few days without it, I can really tell a difference. I use this morning and night after double cleansing and before using Vanicream moisturizer. I don't even wear makeup as much because I love the way my skin looks. I will continue to buy this as long as it exists (please be forever)!
The only real issue I have is the smell, but other than that it works amazing

Tried for a few days, got breakouts. Took a break, tried again, got breakouts again. Gave it to my mom. She got breakouts too. I have dry skin, so I was somewhat surprised to see a product with such a simple ingredients list and mostly hydrating ingredients do this. Just because it broke me out doesn't mean it will for you too, so if have acne prone skin you're curious, try it and keep the receipt. Also is slightly annoying how small the bottle is, The Ordinary products are definitely getting smaller and more expensive posg-acquisition. You can definitely get similar milky toner products from Asian brands for cheaper on sites like Stylevana.
Any skin product takes time to determine its effectiveness. I have tried for a month. So far so good. Toner is difficult to tell since one will place other products on top of it.

I always have struggled to find a toner that isn't drying or irritating. This is really great, so great that I repurchased it! I love the formula. Whether I'm having an acne breakout or my skin is clear, I am able to use it without any irritation. I love this addition to my routine. Highly recommend!
With the second use it made my skin feel bumpy and made my face super dry and itchy. I definitely do not recommend

ive noticed a great difference in texture since using this. i feel like i never noticed a difference with exfoliating toners but this changed my mind. its really hydrating too and gives such a pretty glow to the skin. highly recommend.

I love this. I had to stop using the glycolic acid due to developing skin issues and i had been waiting for the ordinary to drop another toner. This is perfect for sensitive skin. My skin isnt dull after, no burning or irritation, not stripping. It calms my redness and inflammation a bit. The smell is different but it is a fermented product so thats to be expected. I only wish i could buy a bigger bottle. I love this and it has made such a huge difference in my skin.

Where has this been all my life? Immediately after using the discoloration of my face went down so much. It doesn't dry my skin out at all and leaves it looking so glowy. I also have super sensitive skin and this didn't irritate it AT ALL. Trust me, buy this!

I love TO products. I saw this new toner and was supposed to be milder than the glycolic acid toner, but after I used this, my skin felt rough and bumpy. I decided to return it and stick to the glycolic acid toner. My skin feels smooth again.

avis.titre: Perfect! Well worth purchasing again and again.
avis.texte: This toner is the the best and most effective I've ever used. It's very mild, doesn't sting, and leaves your skin feeling soft, very moisturized with a healthy looking glow. It is the only toner I plan on using in my face care regimen.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again
avis.texte: Like this product, it makes my face feel very smooth, and got rid of a dark age spot I had.

I havent bought anything from TO in a few years but i noticed this was new and decided to try it. I love it! I cant say i think my pores look smaller but my skin is so soft and feels nourished. I genuinely enjoy using it in my routine, especially at night. Im excited to see how it affects my skin by the time i finish the bottle.

avis.titre: my skin has never been so smooth
avis.texte: this is definetly oily skin approved! i have been using this product for about a week and a half and my skin has never been so smooth, i also have noticed that my skin toned has evened I use this right after i wash my face before any other serums and its great, its hydrating but not greasy and also really gentle on your skin, just go get it now!

I've been having some texture issues with my skin due to hormonal changes and picked this up on a whim just over a week ago. I have been patting it into the skin with fingers 2x a day after washing since then and i have to say my pores haven't looked this small in many years. My skin feels smooth again and looks much brighter. Along with the texture issues i was experiencing, my skin had been looking a little dull and ruddy, but it looks much more even in tone now (though not perfect by any means) and noticeably brighter. I'm impressed that there have been visible results in a week. My skin also does look and feel more plump as well, but i am unsure if that is the result of this product, the HA + B5 serum (i was using standalone HA before this), or a combination of the two. Either way, these will stay in my routine until it seems like they aren't working for me anymore.

This is the best exfoliant I have tried. I only use this at night with the skin cycling method. The next day my skin is so hydrated and smooth. It's a noticeable difference! Even when I fall off my routine, I rely on this product to reset my skin. I have dehydrated/textured/dull/combo skin. Before this I was using the glycolic acid which was becoming too harsh. I'm so happy I made the switch!
I've been using The Ordinary Saccharomyces Ferment toner, and I couldn't be happier with the results! My skin!feels incredibly soft and smooth, almost like I've had a professional facial.

This toner is fantastic, feels super silky and hydrating. Love how luxurious it feels when applying and how a little goes a long way. It does smell a little like beer because of the yeast but its fairly faint and the smell goes away once applied.
this toner fixed my broken skin barrier since i had so many scars and ive never gotten so many complimemts on how my skin is glowing defff recommend😍
I use it every morning and every night and I LOVE love is a understatement I would die if I never would have tried it

I have sensitive, oily skin and this product has been working so well with my skin. I've been using this every morning on my face and neck for a week; so far it hasn't broken me out. It smells like spoiled milk but its hydrating and leaves my skin feeling soft!
I wanted to love this product but it gave me a terrible rash after 1 use! I don't consider myself to have senstive skin at all! Now I have a red, itchy bumpy face 😫
The result is very subtle. No irritation, no dryness, no breakouts…for me. Just skin that feels like I have a healthy skin barrier. I already repurchased.
Despite the strong cheesy smell, its a really nice toner. It exfoliates really nicely, but didnt irritate my skin. For more context, I used a cotton pad to apply the toner.
I was using Pink Drink by SUNDAY RILEY when I decided to give this a try. Great product. (It might even be a little bit better!) Beautiful skin- a lot less money 💰. That's hard to beat.

I have been using this for about a week and I have noticed such an amazing result. My redness has gone down, my skin is soft and glowy without looking greasy, and it helped my texture. The product is very liquidy with little to no smell but i has such an amazing moisturizing factor towards it. I will definitely repurchase this when i run out!!
This is a great priduct if youre wanting that fresh glowy dewy looking skin. After patting in skin is plump to thr touch. After applying i go in with a favorite sunscreen.

Something about this stuff is worth writing home about. I love products that actually do something. I'm on day 3 - it makes me a little flush at first, it feels moisturizing but not greasy. I have sensitive, sometimes-acne skin and it hasn't made me break out. My texture is starting to look more even on my entire face. I'm in and will be stocking up. 42 years old and wish I'd found this sooner.

avis.titre: Seeing a difference in one week!
avis.texte: So far I love this milky toner- it hydrates, brightens, and gently exfoliates my skin. I've only been using it for a week and it has already shown those benefits. It's gentle, non-sticky, and pleasant to use. I had small, stubborn flakes on my nose for YEARS that would always come back- even with manual exfoliation (I tried TO's glycolic acid toner but it was too harsh for me to use regularly enough to see results). This milky toner is gentle but still exfoliates, I've been using it twice a day with no irritation. Definitely will repurchase!

I have struggled with OCD and dermatillomania (skin picking) my whole life, but it never got *that* bad until I turned 20 and developed severe and seemingly never-stopping acne. I've been trying for two years to find some sort of solution to help my sensitive skin out, and this is the one toner that has helped, rather than accelerated, my acne. I can finally go out of the house confidently again without having to cake my face with foundation :) I am so so grateful for finding this product. Definitely purchasing again once I run out.

avis.texte: This is my second review to add that my face breaks out easily from heavy exfoliators, especially from salicylic acid! But this toner is gentle and soothing. My skin has become sensitive as I grow older. This leaves my face soft and refreshed. I use twice daily and find not too harsh to use before my retinoid. Also, I am NOT an influencer.
